answer.rationale: p99 latency spike began 90 minutes after release; memory_b1 establishes that rollback cleared a similar checkout error spike without customer impact. However, memory_b2 warns against regional failover during hot writes (settlement peak is active now), which eliminates that option despite its latency benefits. memory_b3 shows capacity additions work but require time we may not have given the acute 5x elevation. Rollback is the fastest path to known stability during heavy transactional load. Verifying b1 confirms rollback safety record; verifying b2 rules out failover given current write conditions. Circuit breaker and read routing don't address write-path latency. Single intervention constraint and settlement peak timing make rollback the highest-confidence play.
